title: Agentic campaign control for high-throughput de novo binder design
authors: Jeon M; Song J; Kim J; Zhong ED
one_liner_zh: 该文提出T-REX智能体框架，利用LLM代理编排多种蛋白生成模型与结构评估器，实现高通量从头设计蛋白结合剂的自动化策略，核心聚焦蛋白质结构生成与设计，方法创新且高度相关。
abstract: Progress in artificial intelligence has produced a rapidly growing ecosystem of methods for de novo protein design. With access to many specialized and often complementary tools, how does one use them effectively, especially with a finite compute budget? Here, we introduce Target-adaptive Rescue-Explore-eXploit (T-REX), an agentic protein binder design framework that orchestrates multiple state-of-the-art protein generative models and structure evaluators. Over the course of a design campaign, T-REX leverages large language model (LLM) agents to reason over accumulating outcomes and decide whether to rescue promising candidates, explore alternative settings, or exploit productive routes, while a deterministic controller validates and schedules proposed actions.
abstract_zh: 人工智能的进步催生了一个快速增长的从头蛋白质设计方法生态系统。面对众多专门且往往互补的工具，如何有效利用它们，尤其是在有限的计算预算下？在此，我们引入靶标自适应-拯救-探索-利用（Target-adaptive Rescue-Explore-eXploit, T-REX）框架，这是一种智能体蛋白质结合剂设计框架，它协调多种最先进的蛋白质生成模型和结构评估器。在设计活动过程中，T-REX利用大型语言模型（LLM）智能体对累积结果进行推理，并决定是拯救有前景的候选物、探索替代设置，还是利用有效路径，同时由确定性控制器验证并调度所提出的行动。
